requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/deepEqual.js` and your own tests in `tests/deepEqual.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `deepEqual(a, b)`: structural equality for primitives (NaN equals NaN), arrays, plain objects (key order irrelevant) and Dates (by time). Different types are never equal; arrays never equal objects; cyclic structures are not required.
